title_zh: 把同伴作品的赞美写得具体

scenario.label_zh: 用作品证据完善同伴反馈
scenario.goal_zh: 把笼统好评改为对清楚步骤图的具体赞赏，并确认保留诚实的改进意见

context_zh: 学生在提交同伴评价前检查措辞。
author: author-phase08-c

sentences.speaker: Ellis
sentences.text: Our teacher asked for feedback from a peer. I just wrote that your whole project was outstanding.

sentences.speaker: Noor
sentences.text: That's kind, but which part actually helped you understand the idea?

sentences.speaker: Ellis
sentences.text: The diagram showing the steps. I want to praise the way you made a complicated process easy to follow.

sentences.speaker: Noor
sentences.text: That means more to me. I took a lot of pride in getting those arrows right.

sentences.speaker: Ellis
sentences.text: I'll write that specific point, and mention that the final label was hard to read.

sentences.speaker: Noor
sentences.text: Please do. I can use that when I revise it.

targets.sense_zh: 同龄或同等身份的同伴
